parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is a button of the remote made of silicone rubber, typically circular and slightly raised for tactile feedback.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a user input interface to send commands when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position due to elasticity.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is another button of the remote made of silicone rubber, similar in structure but possibly assigned to a different function.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to control a different function of the remote device.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position due to elasticity.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the remote, made of ABS plastic, forming the main structural housing.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the internal components and provides a surface for the buttons and electronics.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support for the entire remote.
